messages.subject: Additive hazards model
parts: Dear all, I was using the spatial extension of the Cox proportional hazards model implemented in INLA. But I am also very interested in the additive hazards model that allows an evaluation of absolute rather than relative risks. Is it feasible to implement this model from the existing code? Thank you. Olivier
